_schema._lee_esto_primero: Este bloque documenta el formato y no es dato de la app. Se conserva en cada export para que el esquema viaje con el archivo: quien lo consuma no necesita buscar otro documento. Las apps que adopten este formato copian este bloque tal cual y rellenan el resto.
_schema._origen: Definido por app-dash-agent-ai en su entrega de brochure (2026-08-19). Es el PRIMER export del portafolio; las demás apps lo adoptan.
_schema._consumidor: La vitrina de hoja-de-vida. Renderiza la ficha de cada app sin abrir su repositorio.
_schema._regla_madre: Toda cifra de `metricas[]` lleva su etiqueta de `fuente`. Es la regla dura 3 de Dash Agent AI aplicada a su propia ficha: una app que exige procedencia a cada número de su pantalla no puede publicar cifras sueltas sobre sí misma. Se recomienda al resto del portafolio.
_schema.schema_version: semver del FORMATO, no de la app. Cambio mayor = campo eliminado o con significado distinto; menor = campo nuevo opcional; parche = documentación.
_schema.app.estado: "inicial" mientras el brochure describe la construcción cerrada; "sellado" cuando el gate de pruebas del usuario terminó. `sellado_en` es null hasta entonces.
_schema.funcionalidades.total: El número que el brochure declara en su pie. `fuente_del_conteo` dice contra qué documento se cuadró — sin eso, el total es una afirmación.
_schema.funcionalidades.descartadas: Las que se construyeron o se planearon y NO existen. Van aquí con su razón y su fecha para que nadie las cuente como pendientes ni como entregadas.
_schema.metricas[].fuente: Una de cuatro: "medido" (salió de un contador o un comando), "calculada" (medido operado con una tarifa o una regla, y se dice cuál), "declarado" (lo fijó una persona), "estimacion" (deducido). Una cifra sin fuente no entra.
_schema.enlaces.produccion: null cuando la app no tiene URL pública. `razon` explica por qué, y es lo que la vitrina muestra en lugar del enlace. Nunca se rellena con un enlace de repositorio ni con una promesa.

promesa.tagline: I planned, built and measured the gap.
promesa.intro: You write the plan as a contract —decisions, risks, assumptions, criteria and thresholds, each one measurable— and planlang uses it to build the agent, run it on cases with a known answer and publish the gap. Then you move a threshold and see what it would have cost.
promesa.para_quien: For whoever plans, builds or approves an AI-agent project and today measures what the agent does without having written down first what it was supposed to do: they look at traces, run loose evaluations and decide by eye when a result is enough.
promesa.diferencial: Observing traces and evaluating answers is done by many tools. What nobody does is demand the plan first and measure against it afterwards: the plan → result gap report, with the prior risk analysis, and the plan's thresholds playable over the real traces.

grupos.linea: The plan as a contract: templates, validator and the builder's contract.

features.que_hace: Typical actors, decisions, risks and criteria for health and financial onboarding, with the legal constraints in plain language and with their source.
No plan is approved with a criterion without a measurement rule, a threshold without a signal or a high-priority risk without mitigation; it says exactly what is missing.
The plan hands over the nodes, the edges as signal · operator · value, the human pauses and the signals the trace must record; what the agent decides is literally what the plan says.

grupos.linea: Cases with a known truth, demo A and batch runs.

features.nombre: Synthetic cases with a known truth
features.que_hace: Reproducible seeded batches: normal, edge, incomplete and adversarial; a validator guarantees that no identifier could be real.
A router, an extractor, a rule-based coverage checker and a drafter approve, deny with a stated cause or escalate to an auditor; no denial goes out without a person.
Every denial produces, by code, a document in Spanish and English with the cause, the rule, the data used and the way to contest it.
Accumulable batches without duplicate cases, with the model served by the Claude Code subscription; traces are exported to an own, versioned format.

grupos.linea: The gap verifier and assumptions measured for real.

features.que_hace: Reads plan, traces and evaluations and says, criterion by criterion and risk by risk, what was met and in which cases it was not; it emits the report in Spanish and English, identical byte for byte.
“The model extracts with calibrated confidence” is measured for real —calibration and risk-coverage curve— and ends up confirmed, refuted or untested.
Seeded gaps the verifier must detect, flawed plans it must reject and the cross-check that the playground reproduces the agent's branches.

metricas.etiqueta: criteria met across the plans of 2 demos, of 15
metricas.detalle: Demo A: 9 of 9, in verifier 1.2.0's report on run suscripcion-planlang-a-001-20-v1.2. Demo B: 6 of 6, in verifier 1.2.0's report on run suscripcion-planlang-b-001-20.

metricas.etiqueta: decisions redone in another language, with 0 differences
metricas.detalle: RF-09.2 cross-check over 6 runs of 2 demos: the TypeScript edge interpreter redoes every decision Python recorded.

metricas.etiqueta: synthetic cases with a known answer, across 2 demos
metricas.detalle: Demo A: 20 cases in run suscripcion-planlang-a-001-20-v1.2, 2 repetitions (pass^k) and the single-agent baseline. Demo B: 20 cases in run suscripcion-planlang-b-001-20 and the single-agent baseline.

metricas.etiqueta: model calls when visiting the showcase
metricas.detalle: Set by the architecture: the showcase is a static export with precomputed data; the package is tested without a single request outside its origin.

metricas.etiqueta: nominal cost of running each demo once (40 cases)
metricas.detalle: Demo A: US$ 0.6704 for 20 cases. Demo B: US$ 0.293 for 20 cases. Sum of the nominal cost the CLI declares per call, over each run's traces; through the subscription it was not paid separately.

privacidad.detalle: Every case, member, physician, benefit plan, applicant and watchlist is synthetic, from a seed, and an identifier validator in CI rejects any with a real-looking form. The showcase is static: no visitor triggers calls to models or services.

enlaces.razon: The private app is not published. The showcase travels to hoja-de-vida as a static package, labeled “Simulation · not operational”, and is shown there.
enlaces.razon_repositorio: The repository is not linked from the showcase (the portfolio's zero-links rule).
enlaces.brochure_archivo: no file of its own: the showcase and its records serve as the brochure (sprint 3 decision)
enlaces.brochure_ruta_local: no /conoce route: the showcase is the app's presentation (sprint 3 decision)
